About this Event

Desi Dreams Winter Mixer: Marriage-Minded South Asian Singles (Ages 40–55)

Close out 2026 by meeting intentional, marriage-minded South Asian singles in NYC. We’re taking a relaxed, low-pressure approach—designed for you to freely socialize and make genuine connections without feeling put on the spot.
**How It Works & Mixer Rules:** * **Structured & Social:**

We start with hosted icebreakers to keep things effortless, followed by open mingling , no speed dating.
